title: Continuing from earlier work: resume, fork, or start fresh?
head: Situation
Right mechanism
Why
rows: Two independent directions from the same full state
fork_session
Each branch has the full baseline, neither sees the other
Continue one line of work, nothing changed
--resume
Picks up the same conversation
Continue after files changed a little
--resume and tell the agent what changed
Refresh the stale parts only
Old tool results are widely stale, or context is crowded
New session with a structured summary
Cleaner than resuming on stale data
Only the main findings matter for the next step
New session with a structured summary
Compact, full detail not needed
rule: Divergent continuations from a shared baseline: fork. Linear continuation: resume. Stale or crowded: fresh session with a summary.

title: Coming back to work: how much has changed?
head: Since the session paused
Right move
Why
rows: Nothing changed
--resume and continue
State is still accurate
One or two known files changed
Resume, tell the agent, re-read those files
Cheap, keeps the design context
Many files moved or refactored
New session with a structured summary
Too many stale tool results
Want two different approaches from here
fork_session
Independent branches
Context is nearly full
/compact or a fresh session from a summary
Free space; doesn't refresh files
rule: After resuming, tell the agent about file changes. If a lot moved, start a new session from a structured summary instead.

title: Coming back to an old session: resume, fork or start fresh?
head: Situation
Right mechanism
Why
rows: Little has changed since the last turn
--resume + tell the agent what changed
History is still mostly true
Much of the earlier tool output is now out of date
New session seeded with a structured summary, then re-fetch
Stale results mislead more than they help
Want to try two different approaches from the same point
fork_session
Independent branches from one baseline
Exact amounts get lost in a long conversation
Case-facts block
Protects transactional facts, not tool freshness
Files changed while you were away (coding)
Resume and name the changed files
Lets the agent re-read only what moved
rule: If little changed, resume and say what changed. If a lot changed, start fresh from a structured summary.
